name: Mathematical Paper Marbling
promptTemplate: Algorithmic Ebru bath with {{palette}} pigments in {{pattern_style}} combed geometry, tine density {{comb_density}} and viscosity {{ink_viscosity}} reacting to music at {{audio_reactivity}} intensity.

palette.hint: Cycle pigment sets steeped across ribbons

pattern_style.hint: Switch between classic tine comb sequences

comb_density.hint: Tighter teeth create finer ribbon striations

ink_viscosity.hint: Paces the drag velocity of the comb teeth

audio_reactivity.hint: Scales sound-driven drop volume and fluid shear

listing.blurb: Mathematical paper marbling: drops of ink placed in a bath and dragged by combs and tines using the exact marbling transforms, building feathered and nonpareil patterns.
listing.prompt: Mathematical paper marbling: drops of ink placed in a bath and dragged by combs and tines using the exact marbling transforms, building feathered and nonpareil patterns. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
